spans.s: Śṛṅga, a mountain = Śṛṅgavat. § 574i (Airāvata): VI, 8, 295 (uttareṇa tu Śṛṅgasya samudrānte janādhipa | varsham Airāvataṃ nāma), 296 (B. tasmāc Chṛṅgam ataḥ paraṃ; C. has yasmāc Chṛṅgavataḥ paraṃ, but cf. the note of PCR.)
Śṛṅgavat, a mountain. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 6, 199 (among the six varshaparvatas).--§ 574 (Airāvata): VI, 8, 296 (v. Śṛṅga).--§ 775 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 166, 7658.
Śṛṅgavera, a serpent. § 66 (Sarpasattra): I, 57, 2154 (of Kauravya's race).
Śṛṅgaverapura, a city. § 372 (Tīrthayātrāp.): III, 85, 8207 (there Rāma Dāśarathi formerly crossed [the Gaṅgā]).

Śṛṅgin^1, son of Śamīka. § 51 (Parikshit): I, 40, 1679, 1683; 41, 1690, (1695), 1700, (1703), 1706, 1707; 42, (1725) (Parikshit was cursed by Ś. because he had outraged Śamīka).--§ 56 (do.): I, 50, 1965 (had been born from a cow), 1966 (repetition of § 51).--§ 57 (Janamejaya): I, 50, 2009.--§ 790 (Putradarśanap.): XV, 35, 946 (Śamīkañ ca mahātmānaṃ putran tañ cāsya Śºṇaṃ, they were beheld by Janamejaya when Vyāsa had caused them to come from heaven).
